inputs.text: [excited] It was 6.5 meters long — as long as a road is wide, it takes up the whole street! [quickly] Standing up, it was 2.5 meters tall — as tall as a soccer goal! And it weighed 400 kilos — [amazed] as heavy as 2 lions!
[amazed] One carnivore, all alone, that far away?
[confident] Yes. [proud] The king of the bottom of the world, with no known rival its size.
